name: retroplug2-ui
description: RetroPlug workspace root: the JS build toolchain (esbuild) and the runtime deps bundled into the UI.

scripts.validate:greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-clap retroplug-vst3 && RETROPLUG_CLAP_NAME=retroplug RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug tools/validate-plugins.sh
scripts.reaper:mgb-smoke-greenfield-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-greenfield-rplg.js && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/mgb_smoke_greenfield.rpp build tools/reaper-mgb-greenfield-author.lua build/mgb_greenfield.rplg
scripts.reaper:mgb-smoke-greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-greenfield-rplg.js && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/mgb_smoke_greenfield.rpp build/mgb_greenfield.rplg
scripts.reaper:analyze-smoke-greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli retroplug-example-session && RETROPLUG_USER_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/gfcli-analyze build/bin/retroplug-cli build/greenfield-cli/analyze-mgb.js /tmp/cli-smoke-greenfield.wav && tools/reaper-stage.sh /tmp/cli-smoke-greenfield.wav
scripts.reaper:analyze-lsdj-sync-greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli retroplug-example-session && RETROPLUG_USER_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/gfcli-analyze build/bin/retroplug-cli build/greenfield-cli/analyze-lsdj-sync.js ../resources/roms/lsdj/lsdj9_4_2.gb /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern-greenfield && tools/reaper-stage.sh /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern-greenfield_sys0.wav /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern-greenfield_sys1.wav
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-metro-greenfield-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js midi-metro && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug RP_SCENARIO=midi-metro tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_metro_greenfield.rpp build tools/reaper-lsdj-greenfield-author.lua build/lsdj_midi-metro_greenfield.rplg
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-metro-greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js midi-metro && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_metro_greenfield.rpp build/lsdj_midi-metro_greenfield.rplg && tools/reaper-timing-analyze.py build/reaper-lsdj-midi-metro-greenfield.wav
scripts.reaper:lsdj-arduinoboy-metro-greenfield-: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js arduinoboy-metro && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug RP_SCENARIO=arduinoboy-metro tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_arduinoboy_metro_greenfield.rpp build tools/reaper-lsdj-greenfield-author.lua build/lsdj_arduinoboy-metro_greenfield.rplg
scripts.reaper:lsdj-arduinoboy-metro-greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js arduinoboy-metro && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_arduinoboy_metro_greenfield.rpp build/lsdj_arduinoboy-metro_greenfield.rplg && tools/reaper-timing-analyze.py build/reaper-lsdj-arduinoboy-metro-greenfield.wav
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-drift-greenfield-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js midi-drift && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug RP_SCENARIO=midi-drift tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_drift_greenfield.rpp build tools/reaper-lsdj-greenfield-author.lua build/lsdj_midi-drift_greenfield.rplg
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-drift-greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js midi-drift && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_drift_greenfield.rpp build/lsdj_midi-drift_greenfield.rplg && tools/reaper-timing-analyze.py build/reaper-lsdj-midi-drift-greenfield.wav --drift
